hero.title: Unlock the wisdom in
hero.description: SentientArchive turns your scattered documents into a conversational knowledge base. Stop searching, start asking.

why.title: Why SentientArchive?
why.subtitle: Designed for researchers, writers, and knowledge workers who need more than just storage.

cognitiveSearch.title: Cognitive Search
cognitiveSearch.description: Don't just match keywords. Our AI understands the intent behind your query and surfaces relevant concepts.

autoLinking.title: Auto-Linking
autoLinking.description: New entries are automatically connected to existing knowledge nodes, creating a web of insight without manual effort.

privateByDesign.title: Private by Design
privateByDesign.description: Your knowledge base is encrypted locally. Not even our AI models train on your personal data without consent.

features.title: Everything You Need to Build Your Knowledge Empire
features.subtitle: Powerful AI features to help you capture, organize, and learn from your notes without the friction.

realTimeSearch.title: Real-Time Search
realTimeSearch.description: Find exactly what you are looking for in milliseconds with semantic search capabilities.

activityTracking.title: Activity Tracking
activityTracking.description: Visualize your learning habits and track your productivity with growth over time.

smartNoteTaking.title: Smart Note-Taking
smartNoteTaking.description: Capture ideas instantly with our distraction-free editor designed for speed and clarity.

hierarchicalFolders.title: Hierarchical Folders
hierarchicalFolders.description: Organize your thoughts with infinite nested folders and smart categories.

aiSummarization.title: AI Summarization
aiSummarization.description: Condense long articles and papers into concise summaries automatically.

flashcardGeneration.title: Flashcard Generation
flashcardGeneration.description: Automatically generate study flashcards from your notes to reinforce learning and retention.

autoTagging.title: Auto-Tagging
autoTagging.description: Let AI organize your library by automatically assigning relevant tags and categories.

knowledgeQa.title: Knowledge Q&A
knowledgeQa.description: Ask questions to your knowledge base and get answers based on your notes.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Start building your second brain in three simple steps

unlockInsights.title: Unlock AI Insights
